title: Web-based International Register of Emergency Surgery and Trauma
official: Web-based International Register of Emergency Surgery and Trauma
summary: The WIRES-T project (Web-based International Registry of Emergency General Surgery and Trauma) has been set up to allow to all the EGS (Emergency General Surgery) and Trauma surgeons to register their activity and to obtain a worldwide register of traumatic and non traumatic surgical emergencies. This will give the opportunity to evaluate results on a macro-data basis and to give index allowing stratifying, evaluating and improving the outcomes.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients affected by an acute surgical disease
* Patients with indication to be referred to the emergency surgeon attention
* Patients to be operated or to be treated with non-operative approach without surgical intervention

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patients not affected by an acute surgical disease
* Patients without indication to be referred to the emergency surgeon attention

sites.f: General, Emergency and Trauma surgery, University Hospital of Pisa
